meta.name: Ninja Death Trilogy
meta.description:
All 3 Ninja Death Movies in RMVB and xvid AVI file formats.

WARNING These films have some not-so-safe-for-work scenes (it's a trilogy about dueling brothels, what do you expect?)

AVI's are encoded in xvid with 1200 Video Bit Rate and MP3 320 Bit Rate Audio

Summary From IMDB: Tiger is the owner of a brothel who moonlights as a Kung Fu artist under the watchful eye of "Master." They run into serious trouble when ninjas inexplicably show up and jeopardize Tiger's prostitution ring.
